properties.notes: This site is comprised of a three storey office block and car park owned by the Council and is on the northern edge of Lymington town centre. Given its location on the edge of the town centre, the character of the site and the immediate area adjacent to the site, this site has significant potential to accommodate mixed use development at a high density. he adopted Local Plan Part 2 (2014) currently identifies this site as a town centre opportunity (LYM8.4). Around 100 dwellings
